headline: EA uses AI to bring back John Motson's voice for FC 27
summary: EA Sports used AI to recreate the voice of late BBC football commentator John Motson, who died in February 2023, to provide commentary in FC 27 with the consent of his family. The AI version debuts in the game on 26 November.

claims.statement: EA used AI to recreate late broadcaster John Motson's voice to commentate in FC 27, with his family's consent.
